content.title: Dollar General earnings, Fedspeak, jobless claims: What to Watch
content.description:
Asking for a Trend host Josh Lipton previews several of the biggest stories to come tomorrow, Thursday, December 4, including earnings results from Dollar General (DG), Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE), and Ulta Beauty (ULTA); commentary from Federal Reserve Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman; and the latest reading on initial jobless claims.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Asking for a Trend.
